company.name: Ambient.ai
company.shortDescription: Ambient.ai provides a security platform that applies AI to existing camera infrastructure to sensor and prevent incidents.
company.description: Ambient.ai is an AI-powered physical security platform integrating computer vision intelligence and camera infrastructure to sensor and prevent security incidents. The company specializes in real-time human-level perception technology that enables intelligent environments that are safe, efficient, and sustainable.

aiResearchSummary.text: Ambient.ai is researching systems and methods for correlating access-system primitives with semantic primitives from sensor data, as described in Systems and methods for machine learning enhanced intelligent building access. They are also developing approaches for classifying contextual events as threats, detailed in Systems and methods for machine learning-based site-specific threat modeling. These efforts focus on AI-driven analysis and threat detection using existing camera and sensor infrastructure.
